rows.Name: Service Requests
rows.Description: Contains all service requests submitted by customers. Tracks request details including priority, status, completion date, time spent, and cost estimates. Used for measuring request fulfillment performance and turnaround times.

rows.Name: IncidentsAllFields
rows.Description: Contains all incidents (support cases/tickets) from the system. Each row represents one ticket with comprehensive details like creation date, status, priority, customer contact info, SLA details, and resolution times. This is the main fact table for incident analysis.

rows.Name: Calendar
rows.Description: Master date table for time-based analysis. Contains dates from 2024-2030 with calculated columns for Year, Month, Quarter, and formatted date combinations. Enables drill-down analysis and year-over-year comparisons.

rows.Name: RecordTracker
rows.Description: Tracks all record status changes and activities/events related to incidents. Records when tickets change status, who performed the change, and how long activities took. Used to calculate total process times and understand ticket lifecycle.

rows.Name: TimeSheet
rows.Description: Tracks all record status changes and activities/events related to incidents. Records when tickets change status, who performed the change, and how long activities took. Used to calculate total process times and understand ticket lifecycle.
